name: sh.agentdrive/agentdrive
title: AgentDrive
description: Capture coding-agent sessions and resume them in any other agent: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, more.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTDRIVE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AgentDrive API key. Optional after `npx @adrive/cli auth login`.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTDRIVE_AGENT_PLATFORM
environmentVariables.description: Harness id recorded as provenance, e.g. claude-code or codex.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <AgentDrive API key>. Get one free at https://app.agentdrive.sh (no credit card).
